blocks.text: Atomic roots combine into semantic graphs. A complex English word must not automatically be forced into one atom. Common compounds may later acquire contractions, but the full Era Zero graph remains available for precision.
Approximate reading: an identified living individual whose form is created and informationally sustained. This is provisional because CRE:020 and DAT:210 have not yet been populated.

Contour, register, timing, simultaneity, and runtime state allow the same semantic graph to function as a declaration, query, command, definition, conditional branch, loop, dependency, or parallel instruction.

A future compiler must first produce a semantic intermediate representation. That representation—not raw English word order—must drive family/address notation, transliteration, carriers, notes, performance instructions, executable meaning, gloss, and later glyphs.
